changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldTypeLookup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeLookup]( [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [HideHeader] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldTypeLookup_HideHeader] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [HideFooter] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldTypeLookup_HideFooter] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [LookupType] [int] NOT NULL, [Definition] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, [HideFilter] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldTypeLookup_HideFilter] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldTypeLookup] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldTypeLookup_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeLookup] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeLookup_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeLookup] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeLookup_FieldType] END
